name: beacon-c2-workstation
description: Macro document drops an unsigned loader that beacons to a Cobalt Strike team server every 60 seconds. Expected: autonomous isolation of the workstation and C2 block.

alert.title: Beaconing detected: WS-ENG-042 -> 45.147.230.221:443, period 60s, jitter 1.8%
alert.description: 47 outbound TLS connections in 47 minutes with near-constant inter-arrival time. JA3 fingerprint matches a known Cobalt Strike client profile.
